risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a market with increased competition, with numerous players offering online and campus-based education services. (Item 1A, p. 61)

risks.title: Government Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict government regulations, particularly regarding student financial aid programs. (Item 1A, p. 63)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology to deliver its online education services, which may present risks related to security and reliability. (Item 1A, p. 62)

risks.title: Market Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market fluctuations, particularly regarding interest rates and general economic conditions. (Item 1A, p. 61)

risks.title: Reputation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputation risks, particularly concerning the quality of services provided and student satisfaction. (Item 1A, p. 62)
